business_summary: NWPX Infrastructure, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells water-related infrastructure products in the United States and Canada. It operates through two segments, Water Transmission Systems (WTS); and Precast Infrastructure and Engineered Systems (Precast). The WTS segment manufactures large-diameter, high-pressure steel pipeline systems for use in water infrastructure applications, which are primarily related to drinking water systems. Its products are also used for hydroelectric power systems, wastewater systems, seismic resiliency, and other applications. Its products are also used for hydroelectric power systems, wastewater systems, seismic resiliency, and other applications. The Precast segment offers stormwater and wastewater technology products, precast, and reinforced concrete products, including reinforced concrete pipe, manholes, box culverts, vaults and catch basins, pump lift stations, oil water separators, biofiltration units, and other environmental and engineered solutions. It provides its products under the NWPX Geneva and NWPX Park brand names; and manufactures engineered water transmission systems and produces steel casing pipe, bar-wrapped concrete cylinder pipe, and pipeline system joints and fittings under the Northwest Pipe Company brand. In addition, the company provides solution-based products for various markets, including reinforced precast concrete products, lined precast sanitary sewer system structures, water distribution and management equipment including pump lift stations, wastewater pretreatment, and stormwater quality products. Further, it sells water infrastructure products to installation contractors. The company was formerly known as Northwest Pipe Company and changed its name to NWPX Infrastructure, Inc. in June 2025. NWPX Infrastructure, Inc. was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Washington.
business_summary_ko: NWPX Infrastructure, Inc.는 자회사와 함께 미국과 캐나다에서 물 관련 인프라 제품을 제조 및 판매합니다. 이는 물 전달 시스템(WTS)이라는 두 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 프리캐스트 인프라 및 엔지니어링 시스템(프리캐스트). WTS 부문은 주로 식수 시스템과 관련된 수자원 인프라 응용 분야에 사용되는 대구경, 고압 강철 파이프라인 시스템을 제조합니다. 해당 제품은 수력 발전 시스템, 폐수 시스템, 지진 복원력 및 기타 응용 분야에도 사용됩니다. 해당 제품은 수력 발전 시스템, 폐수 시스템, 지진 복원력 및 기타 응용 분야에도 사용됩니다. 프리캐스트 부문은 철근 콘크리트 파이프, 맨홀, 상자 암거, 금고 및 배수구, 펌프 리프트 스테이션, 유수 분리기, 생물 여과 장치 및 기타 환경 및 엔지니어링 솔루션을 포함한 빗물 및 폐수 기술 제품, 프리캐스트 및 철근 콘크리트 제품을 제공합니다. NWPX Geneva 및 NWPX Park 브랜드 이름으로 제품을 제공합니다. 공학적 물 전달 시스템을 제조하고, 바 포장 강철 케이싱 파이프를 생산합니다.
